raw_source_record.title: Senior Manager, Digital Monetization Growth

raw_workday_record.jobDescription:
The opportunity

Adobe's Digital Monetization Growth team owns monetization funnel performance across the Creative and Marketing Professionals customer group, including Firefly and agentic monetization. We're hiring a Senior Manager to grow monetization for Creative Professionals on desktop and web. This work moves Adobe's revenue directly.

You'll lead a team of growth product managers, set the strategy, and run experiments. If you want to shape how AI gets monetized for creators, this is the seat.

What you'll do

  • Own the paywalls and in-app upsells that turn free users into paid subscribers, and improve them through testing.

  • Set pricing and usage limits for generative AI, including credit and consumption models, and manage credit packs.

  • Contribute to metering and pricing for agentic and AI-assistant experiences, with a focus on cost and margin.

  • Run a consistent A/B testing program: form hypotheses, size the impact, and prioritize with data.

  • Build monetization strategies that connect upgrade moments to the value users get from their work, lifting freemium-to-paid conversion.

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Growth Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and the Business and Modeling Strategy team.

  • Lead and coach a small team across time zones, including Australia.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 5+ years in growth, product management, or monetization for a consumer subscription business, including leading a team.

  • You've moved a revenue or growth number in a product-led-growth business, with monetization work you can point to.

  • Deep expertise in AI feature monetization: pricing and gating generative features, and the unit economics behind them.

  • Comfort with credit and metering mechanics: feature and plan-level metering, soft caps, and fair-use limits.

  • You know subscription packaging across plans, tiers, and offers.

  • You decide what to measure, benchmark, segment, and prioritize from data with Data Science.

  • Clear communication with senior leaders. You take a position and back it with facts.

  • Experience with creative software, SaaS, or AI-native products is a plus.

raw_workday_record.jobDescription:
The Opportunity 

This is an outstanding opportunity where you will build and launch a new offering within Adobe, working within a team that is incubating next-generation ideas. You will lead a team of engineers, designers, and prototypers to bring a product to life, test it with customers, and demonstrate product-market fit.

This role offers the chance to operate as a startup founder while having the resources of a large technology company. Join us to invent new technologies and power a product that serves the next generation of creators!

The Challenge 

  • Function as the GM for a new incubation venture within Adobe 
  • Build and implement a solution for independent creators that supports their success
  • Define the vision for the full stack of creator services, e.g., brand deal discovery, negotiation, storefront management, affiliate program setup
  • Build and lead a small but mighty team across Research, Engineering, Prototyping, Product and/or Design, to deliver on the product vision. 
  • Build and maintain the product roadmap, identifying new opportunities based on user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
  • Lead market research, competitive analysis, and user discovery with creators
  • Craft a go-to-market plan that incorporates partnerships with relevant creator platforms and communities 
  • Own the P&L for the product and run budget accordingly. 

What's needed to succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience preferred 
  • 12+ years of experience as a Product leader or startup operator, preferably with a background in building consumer or creator-facing products 
  • Deep understanding of how creators build audiences, monetize their work, and manage their businesses
  • Build a vision for how Generative AI can reimagine this stack by automating complex workflows, surfacing the right insights and energize every creator to be a successful solopreneur or small business.
  • Proven ability to influence and rally a variety of collaborators around the vision and gain alignment to implement 
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills 
  • Ability to converse fluently with Engineers/Developers on technical concepts related to AI/ML
  • Proven organizational skills, with the ability to run multiple threads simultaneously and prioritize effectively. 
  • Passion for crafting outstanding experiences and driving business growth through delivering on the needs of creators
  • Strong desire to take an idea from 0 to 1, with a focus on bringing solutions that make a creator’s business easier to run and more profitable.
